AI and verification

Quick readMore contextTechnical detailSpeaker notes

Where can AI reduce friction, and where must human judgment remain?

My example

AI can accelerate code, analysis, documentation, and proposed experiments. Checking that output still takes time and expertise. Confidence and a fluent explanation are not acceptance criteria.

Question for the room. As producing research artifacts becomes cheaper, how do we keep checking them from becoming the next bottleneck?

A practical next step

Pair AI-assisted work with deterministic checks, explicit evidence requirements, and an accountable human reviewer.

Progress would mean: Review time and correction rates, together with the quality of the final evidence.

Agenda connection: Resource Guide, p. 13. Suggested breakout: Track A · Barriers to translation. Track placement and proposals are my contributions; the handouts provide the discussion context.
